live_checks: inst nodes: 0 — every part is a composition from tokens (no library instance to verify: no set, props or text layers).
key frame: after touchTexts and relayout, the frame index (naming) keeps its two columns (184 px board, the rest frames) and each frames cell wraps inside its column; the frame hugs its height.

T2 specimen: the icon 'locked' (CMP-019 lock stand-in) and the label 'Place 5 orders, 1.000 BTC total' both read color.text.tertiary; the control's fill color.surface.raised with a color.border.default hairline; the reason 'one-click off — Ctrl+Shift+T to arm' in color.text.secondary under it.
glyphs: '→', '…', '—', '–', '·', '§', '↑', '↓' render in Inter and JetBrains Mono without a fallback font.
entry points: the Scaled tab (label + tag) and the Targets… button stay 24 px tall, the tag on the label's line.
root: hugs its content (about 2688 x 2425 px estimated); after the first section the root must read back exactly as the sheet's board.name
deviations: Local helpers in gen_01.py (e32kit is not edited): naming() adds one §0 frame name per naming-key clause and §0's board table (L53-67) to the kit's naming key; held_specimen() is the kit's floor_specimen('held') with §3.2 L162's trigger words ('on commit: empty →', 'looser → the value reverts') over its two commit lines; _note_first() puts the naked and draft specimens' CMP-158 right under the stop row, before the submit (§4.3 L412; the submit is the footer's, §3.1 L154-155), where the kit's floor_specimen() draws it after the submit; _naked_notes() replaces the kit's live-region notes on the naked row's sl.naked.attach line (above the field, §3.2 L163; the naked announcement is row 18's banner, §4.3 L400, §3.7 L263) and sltp.naked.recorded (the field's description, §3.8 L285); floor() and classes() add §3.2 L167-169's closing rule and §3.3 L182's CMP-227 sentence, and classes() puts §3.3 L177's 'Trails:' label back between the exchange-held class's two sentences; t2_gate() replaces the kit's t2_specimen(); scaled_tab() composes CMP-103's one 'Scaled' tab with its tag; specimen() captions a specimen with its state row.

t2_gate(): the kit's t2_specimen() pairs a validity hold reading 'Place 5 orders, 1.000 BTC total' with SCR-065 row 1's reason 'Nothing to place yet', which only blank inputs give (L567: no count or total exists there); this board draws the two holds that are not T2 on SCR-064's Apply instead (row 15, 'No changes to apply'; row 10, 'Applying…') and adds §3.6 L242-243's lead (which controls take T2: every role- or state-gated control, rendered inline, 2a), L247-248 (one panel notice) and L255-256 (the press) to T2's parts.

Both board 01 frames sit on the kit's documentation surface (color.surface.canvas); the entry-points frame is 640 px wide (the spec gives no size for a key frame; the key frame keeps the kit's KEY_W 1240).
Today's disabled 'Scaled (emulated)' tab (E30-D02 §7) is not drawn: SCR-060 is not redrawn (§6.4 L693; ruling Q2) and that disabled control and its gate are E30's owner's; sentence (1) names it.

The draft specimen draws its submit's validity hold and no error summary: §3.2 L164's 'a row in the error summary' inserts only on a Place press (§5.4 row 11; §6.3 row 6); boards 07 and 12 annotate it as well.
The naming key collapses the double space left where the backticks of ' · <variant>' are dropped (L49).
Pointer and specimen captions ('→ SCR-065 · boards 07–10', 'SCR-064 / applied (§4.3 row 15)', …) are board chrome: they name the screen or the state row a control is taken from.

'Targets…' is drawn as a secondary CMP-001 button and the 'Scaled' tab unselected with its label in color.text.primary: §6.4 names 'a control' and 'the tab', no variant (low-fidelity choice; E30's owner's hi-fi).

The registry glyph 'pending' on this board is the busy glyph leading 'Applying…' (the kit's CMP-001 loading stand-in, deviation 'busy'; §4.3 row 10's hourglass is on the stop row, not drawn here); the kit's HOURGLASS fallback line names the glyph mapping only.
Spec text quoted on the boards drops its markdown backticks.
Every control is a composition from tokens, named '<CMP id> <Name> (composition)': the wireframes are greys only, and cvsheet v1 cannot recolour an instance or swap its glyph.

Segmented controls draw the anatomy's words verbatim, the selected one in capitals as written (BUY, LIMIT; §5.1 L458, §6.1 L628) and marked by the selected fill; the unit switch's '*' (L330) is that fill.
A validity hold (§3.6 L250-252: 'the host's call') is drawn as the control's own look with its reason as a description and no lock glyph: the spec does not draw it.
The busy state (CMP-001 loading, aria-busy; §3.6 L251-252) is the control's own look with the 'pending' glyph leading its busy label; E30-D02 D17's in-button progress bar is hi-fi.

Every number is JetBrains Mono (§3.1 L155) in fields, cells, tiles and the read-out pairs; a number inside a sentence keeps the sentence's Inter, because a cvsheet v1 text node carries one typography.
Frame captions, annotation labels, board titles, source lines and footers are board chrome, not product copy.
1 px outlines use cvlib's default stroke (1 px, inner) without binding border.hairline; 2 px boundaries and rings bind border.thick / border.focus (frames stay small: FRAME_NOTE).
